context: A teacher reviews a teen project
purpose: Teach: 転倒/手当て/灰色/大小/スカイ/ナビ/相手方/袖

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、地域安全研究、転倒事故、扱いましたね。
lines.en: Sakura, you covered local safety and fall prevention in your research, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging acknowledgment. Steady eye contact. Opening nod of recognition — she's already noticed the work. Measured pace, no pressure.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。応急手当ての教室、参加した経験、書きました。
lines.en: Yes. I wrote about my experience attending first-aid training classes.
lines.style: Straightforward and sincere. Slight lift of pride — not boastful, just honest about what she did. Direct eye contact back. Grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 灰色の判断が必要な場面、複雑ですね。
lines.en: Those grey-area moments are complex though, aren't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful lean forward. Not a question despite the rise — more an invitation to go deeper. Warm but serious. The tone of someone who respects the complexity herself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 事故の大小、データで整理しています。
lines.en: I've been organizing the data by severity of accident — trying to see the patterns.
lines.style: Focused and methodical. Slight pace pick-up when mentioning the data work — she's engaged with this part. Confident without arrogance. Testing whether the teacher thinks this approach makes sense.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: スカイツリー周辺の調査、感想いかがでしたか。
lines.en: What were your impressions from the survey you did around Skytree?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity in the voice. Slow, patient. Opens space for her to think before answering. The listening quality of a teacher who actually wants to hear the answer.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 観光客のナビ、迷う方多くて、印象的でした。
lines.en: A lot of tourists were getting lost with navigation — it was striking how often it happened.
lines.style: Animated, almost surprised tone. The energy of someone recalling something unexpected. Slight quickening as the realization lands again. Real observation, not rehearsed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 事故の相手方、感情面のケア、論じていますね。
lines.en: You've also thought about the emotional care for the person involved in the accident.
lines.style: Approving recognition. Slight warmth on 'also' — noticing she went further than expected. Measured, not effusive. The tone of someone who sees her thinking grow.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 袖の反射シールも、研究範囲に入れました。
lines.en: I included reflective sleeve bands in the scope too — adding another layer of prevention.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. Slight lingering emphasis on 'included' — small pride in thoroughness. Brings the thought to close gently. Composed, not rushing to finish.
